headline: Adani Energy Solutions wins 1,750 MW renewable contract
summary: Adani Energy Solutions has secured a contract to supply 1,750 MW of renewable power in West Bengal, marking a significant order win for the company.

headline: Natco Pharma receives 7 USFDA Form 483 observations
summary: Natco Pharma received seven USFDA Form 483 observations following an inspection of its Kothur formulation facility, signalling regulatory scrutiny at the site.

headline: Stocks to Watch Today: Ashoka, Adani, Waaree in focus
summary: Infra and energy stocks lead as Ashoka Buildcon bags ₹1,465 cr NHAI order and Adani Energy wins 1,750 MW contract. Kama Holdings eyes ₹350 cr buyback.

headline: Seamec vessel Swordfish off-hired due to breakdown
summary: Seamec Ltd's vessel SEAMEC SWORDFISH was off-hired on November 22, 2026, following a technical breakdown. The company stated repairs are underway with resumption updates to follow.

headline: Creative Newtech wins Samsung premium partner award
summary: Creative Newtech Limited received the 'Highest Growing Premium Partner – Monitor Biz' award at the Samsung VD Leadership Summit 2026 in South Korea, recognizing its growth in Samsung's premium monitor business.

headline: Lord's Mark secures license for radiation-free breast cancer screening
summary: Lord's Mark Industries has obtained a manufacturing license for its radiation-free breast cancer screening device, aiming for commercial launch in January 2027 with tests priced under ₹700.

headline: L&T Technology Services launches SDVault.ai for SDVs
summary: L&T Technology Services launched SDVault.ai, an AI-powered engineering toolchain for Software-Defined Vehicles, featuring 250+ domain-aware AI agents and early pilots showing 30-40% additional engineering capacity.

headline: India mulls 30% export duty on non-basmati rice
summary: India is considering a 30% export duty on non-basmati rice to curb exports, boost domestic availability, and control rising local rice prices.

headline: Pernod Ricard weighs IPO of India business
summary: Pernod Ricard is considering an IPO of its India business to deepen local presence and unlock shareholder value, with the proposal likely to be discussed at its January board meeting.

headline: India 10-year bond yield eases to 7.1797%
summary: India's 10-year benchmark government bond yield fell to 7.1797% from the previous close of 7.1868%, reflecting a marginal easing in sovereign borrowing costs.

headline: Apollo Micro subsidiary bids for IEC Group
summary: Apollo Defence Industries issued a binding EOI to acquire 100% of Integrated Electric Co Group, marking entry into indigenous electrical rotating machines for defence platforms.

headline: Indo Farm promoter group stake rises to 71.25%
summary: Indo Farm Equipment Ltd promoter group acquired 3,00,000 shares via open market. Holding increases to 71.25% from 70.63%.

headline: L&T secures ₹2,500-5,000 crore AI order
summary: Larsen & Toubro wins large contract to deploy NVIDIA B300 GPUs for AI infrastructure at its Chennai campus, strengthening India's AI capabilities.

headline: Max Estates sells out 'The Bungalows' phase at ₹2,319 crore
summary: Max Estates fully sold out the initial phase of 'The Bungalows', with 131 homes sold for around ₹2,319 crore. The project launch was overbooked, with total project value estimated at about ₹4,000 crore.

headline: MobiKwik's Zaakpay integrates Visa Payment Passkey
summary: Zaakpay enables device-based authentication for Visa cardholders, eliminating SMS OTPs. This move supports RBI's 2025 authentication guidelines and aligns with MobiKwik's rapid merchant GMV growth.

headline: ICICI Prudential AMC appoints two independent directors
summary: ICICI Prudential AMC appointed Prof. Sadhu Trilochan Sastry and re-appointed Ms. Preeti Reddy as independent directors for five-year terms.

headline: APL Apollo Tubes to host investor call on Nov 23
summary: APL Apollo Tubes Limited will conduct an analyst and institutional investor conference call on Monday, November 23, 2026, at 6:30 pm IST. Key management personnel will participate.

headline: Welspun Enterprises targets 20% order book CAGR
summary: Welspun Enterprises targets 20% order book CAGR, 15% revenue growth, 18%+ EBITDA margin, and 18% ROCE as part of its strategic growth objectives.

headline: Bank of Baroda EGM on Dec 21 for Director Elections
summary: Bank of Baroda schedules an EGM for December 21, 2026, to elect a shareholder director and approve the reappointment of Lal Singh and appointment of Hari Har Mishra.

headline: Bajaj Finserv shares flag large-trade signal on NSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 1,64,345 Bajaj Finserv shares changing hands on NSE at ₹1,885.50, with combined value of ₹30.99 crore.

headline: Signature Global GRESB score hits 97.8
summary: Signature Global India Ltd achieved a GRESB score of 97.8, up from 84 last year, securing a 4-Star rating and 12th global rank among residential peers.

headline: CreditAccess Grameen hosts Avendus investor meet
summary: CreditAccess Grameen Limited scheduled a virtual one-to-one investor meeting with Avendus Wealth Management on November 23, 2026, at 4:00 pm IST.
